title: Create and validate dark cafeteria orbit map variant
objective: Create a flashlight-validation dark map variant for cafeteria_500sqft_v2 and validate whether it fixes scene_off_flashlight_off brightness. Use Scout's recommendation as the plan. Do not modify product source, tests, docs, or git. You may create run-directory scripts/config/logs under .control-tower/runs only. All Unreal/editor/cook/render processes must run in a named tmux session. Target map path: /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark. Preserve the original cafeteria_500sqft_v2 map/assets. Build the variant by duplicating or reusing the v2 map geometry, then remove/darken non-ULight residual contributors: visible exterior_daylight_context meshes/materials, pale_sky_strip_above_exterior_wall, exterior visible-through-window actors/assets, warm_diffused_led_lens emission, rectangular_led_panel_diffuser_0..3, and warm_wall_sconce_lens_0..1. Set world/precomputed lighting settings where available so the variant has no baked/precomputed lighting. Keep fixture lights movable/dynamic so runtime scene-off disabling can make the map dark. Then cook/package if needed and run orbit validation against the new map using examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh render with --map-path pointing at the dark map and output-dir examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_validation_dark_map. Compute and report scene_off_flashlight_off median mean luma and key metadata fields. Stop and return blocked if Unreal editor APIs cannot create/save the variant without product-code changes.

artifacts: For bright scene-off orbit renders on cafeteria_500sqft_v2, repair the asset first: create a no-baked/no-emissive/no-daylight flashlight-validation map variant and require scene_off_flashlight_off median mean luma below 20 before treating scene_off_flashlight_on as flashlight-only. Lower-level USpSceneCaptureComponent2D show-flag/readback support is the fallback if the dark map cannot satisfy that acceptance check.

expected_outputs: ResultPacket with run_dir, tmux attach command, exact scripts/commands/logs, dark map path, validation output path, luma metrics, metadata verdict, and whether acceptance passed.
definition_of_done: Either a saved/cooked dark validation map has been created and orbit validation shows scene_off_flashlight_off median mean luma below 20.0, or the packet explains the exact blocker and next Builder handoff. No product source/docs/test changes and no git actions.
